game_title: Trace Table Race – Mill Stream Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in The Kingdom – Mill Stream, a stream-side windmill: the baker's apprentice must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Trace Table Race: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program.
theme: The Kingdom – Mill Stream: a stream-side windmill
core_gameplay_loop: In Mill Stream, repeat each round: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the trace_rows_correct value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 14 consecutive correct decisions about trace_rows_correct to power up the baker's apprentice and open the royal vault.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 10 (extended tier): Trace Table Race
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Trace Table Race' (Week 1 slot 14), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Mill Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_rows_correct changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Mill Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 14.
